turns.doctor_question: How much time would you say you spend each day thinking about or checking this spot on your jaw and neck?
turns.patient_response: It takes up a good amount of time, honestly. Um, especially in the mornings. Right before I leave for work or go to a meeting, I just keep going back to the bathroom mirror. symptom_reasoning.S068: The patient describes repetitive mirror checking, camouflaging with hair and collar, phone camera checks, and reassurance seeking from her daughter regarding her neck and jaw.

turns.doctor_question: Besides being late to work or meetings because of the checking, has this concern about your jaw and neck affected other areas of your life—like your relationships, your job performance, or your ability to enjoy things you normally would?

symptom_reasoning.S068: The patient describes engaging in repetitive checking and camouflaging behaviors, such as ensuring it is covered up and checking their appearance before going anywhere.
